verified_candidates.title: Situatia statistica a somajului la 31 iulie 2026
verified_candidates.observed_fact: Official AJOFM Valcea statistics listing exposes the July-2026 statistical publication dated 03.09.2026. The controlled wrapper used in this run does not expose a source-exact unemployment value, therefore no numeric value is added.
verified_candidates.claim_boundary: Publication freshness only; administrative unemployment context is not AI/digital-skill need prevalence and contributes zero H1-H5 points.

verified_candidates.title: 5,80% - rata somajului inregistrat in evidentele AJOFM Ialomita in luna iulie 2026
verified_candidates.observed_fact: Official AJOFM Ialomita homepage currently lists the July-2026 registered-unemployment item with source-exact value 5,80% and publication date 01.09.2026.
verified_candidates.claim_boundary: Registered unemployment is administrative labour-market context only; it does not measure AI/digital competence gaps or training-demand prevalence and contributes zero H1-H5 points.

verified_candidates.title: PROGRAME DE FORMARE PROFESIONALA _Septembrie 2026
verified_candidates.observed_fact: AJOFM Harghita states that September 2026 training includes a digital-competence programme at Toplita, alongside other occupational courses; access is for registered jobseekers under the conditions described by the source.
verified_candidates.claim_boundary: Training supply and access are not a measurement of employer/adult need prevalence, AI skill-gap prevalence or causal need; contributes zero H1-H5 points.
